__NOTOC__[[File:Traits.png|thumb|300x300px|right]]
'''Traits''' are modifiers that boost unit’s stats ('''Damage''', '''SPA''' & '''Range'''). When you summon a unit or obtain it from a portal, it might come with a trait. Additionally, you can reroll traits through the use of[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnants''' or [[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]''' Reroll Tokens'''.
==Rerolling Traits==
[[File:Traits2.png|thumb|300x300px|right]]
To reroll traits, interact with '''Ethereal Guide''', who is outside the '''Evolve''' area in the lobby (can be teleported to by using '''Traits and Evolve''' shortcut). Currently, there are two ways to reroll a trait: using[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnants''' or [[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Tokens'''.  
<hr>
[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnants''' can be obtained from the [[Travelling Merchant Shop]], by completing [[Challenges|Daily Challenges]], from removing '''Shinies''' (by interacting with '''Lucil''' in the lobby), by defeating a '''Star Golem''' in latest [[Infinite|Infinite Mode]], or a 0.25% chance from summons. If the player is using[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnants''' to reroll a trait, the amount required depends on the unit the trait is being rerolled on:  
*{{Rarity|Mythic}} and {{Rarity|Secret}} units require 5[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnants''' per reroll,
*{{Rarity|Rare}}, {{Rarity|Epic}} and {{Rarity|Legendary}} units require 1[[File:StarRemnant.png|35x35px]]'''Star Remnant''' per reroll.
<hr>[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Tokens''' can be obtained from [[Battlepass|Battlepasses]], Evolution Quests or other events. Any unit will require only 1[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Token''' per roll.[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Tokens''' can be also bought: 
*1[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Token''' for 129 R$ ($1.62 USD)
*10[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Tokens''' for 999 R$ ($12.49 USD)
*50[[File:Reroll Token.png|35px]]'''Reroll Tokens''' for 4500 R$ ($56.25 USD)

Ideal trait for units with 3 placements, like [[Illusionist (Final)]], [[Priest (Heaven)]], [[Hubris (The One)]], [[Berserker (Rage)]], [[Tango (Flash God)]], [[Stringy (Awakened)]] or [[Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas)]].

Perfect trait for units with high individual '''DPS''' but low (1 - 2) placement cap, like [[JIO (Over Heaven)]], [[Iron Knight (Arsenal)]], [[Usurper (Founder)]], [[Time Wizard (Chronos)]], [[Skeleton Knight (King)]], [[Illusionist (Transcended)]]  or [[Supreme Being (Sovereign)]]. These units can even outperform their 3 placements counterparts.

Although units with 4+ placements have either a weak group '''DPS''' increase or even a '''DPS''' decrease, it can still be a useful trait for progressive gamemode due to being 4+ times cheaper to max.

== Trivia ==
*When evolving a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit to {{Rarity|Mythic}}, its trait will be transfered. Therefore, rolling a trait on its {{Rarity|Legendary}} form will be 5 times cheaper. 
**Units that can benefit from this are [[Fox Ninja (Beast Cloak)]], [[Usurper]], [[Martial Demon]], [[Gene]], [[Experiment X (Semi-Perfect)]].
*Although Superior, Nimble and Range are {{Rarity|Rare}} traits, their third variant (III) has an {{Rarity|Epic}} rarity, indicated by a purple trait symbol and label.
*There is a '''0.2%''' chance that you can receive '''double trait''' on one unit while rerolling traits.
**When this happens, total percentage boost of two traits will be added.  
***Double Superior III would give a 30% '''Damage''' boost.
***Double Unique would give a 600% '''Damage''' boost, 20% '''SPA''' reduction, and a 20% '''Range''' boost.
*Newly obtained units have a '''1%''' chance to gain a trait. If successful, there is a '''further 1% chance''' to gain '''double traits'''. 
*Unique can make some units as good or better than some '''Meta''' units.
*Culling, despite being a {{Rarity|Legendary}} trait, has a very weak effect, barely outperforming Superior I (on average).
*In most circumstances, Reaper is equivalent to Superior III.
*While '''Range''' boosts do not affect unit's '''Damage''' or '''SPA''', with the right placement units with traits that boost '''Range''' might have more opportunity for attacking, thus increasing average '''DPS'''.
*Golden is the only trait that effects farm units such as [[C.E.O.]] and [[Bulby]], giving 20% more gold each wave.
